propositions: After a successful new-writer save, the inline last_get_pass field must be absent from all entries in bindings.json
When sidecar persistence fails, the primary binding save must succeed and retain the latest inline value as a failure floor
A crash after sidecar replace but before bindings replace cannot lose the chronological maximum: the max must already be durable in get_rotation.json

The save operation must merge staged inline values into the in-memory sidecar using chronological max, then atomically persist get_rotation.json before removing inline fields and writing bindings.json
An old-writer/new-writer sequence that reintroduces a later inline stamp must migrate that maximum into get_rotation.json before inline scrubbing
Every writer (GHA reconciler and local probe) must be upgraded to an A2-1-or-newer binary before A2-2 closure, proven via descendant reconcile-bridge run and refreshed host probe executable
